skill.name: azure-ai-openai-dotnet
skill.description: Guides developers using the Azure.AI.OpenAI .NET SDK for Azure OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible services. Covers authentication, chat, streaming, embeddings, image generation, audio, RAG, function calling, and error handling.
skill.summary: Build Azure OpenAI features in .NET with practical SDK patterns and examples.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Azure OpenAI .NET projects often need correct SDK patterns across authentication, chat, embeddings, media, and tools. This skill provides focused examples and guidance for using Azure.AI.OpenAI in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains Azure.AI.OpenAI client setup for API key and Entra ID authentication.
Shows chat completion, async chat, streaming, and multi-turn conversation patterns.
Covers structured outputs, reasoning model options, and token usage tracking.
Provides examples for embeddings, image generation, audio transcription, and text-to-speech.
Documents Azure AI Search integration for RAG and function calling with tools.
Lists key SDK types, related packages, reference links, and error handling patterns.
limitations: Does not create or modify application files by itself.
Does not validate live Azure resource names, deployments, quotas, or permissions.
Examples may need updates when Azure SDK APIs or model names change.
Security controls still require project-specific review before production use.

use_cases.title: Start a .NET Azure OpenAI Prototype
use_cases.description: Use the setup and chat examples to create a small proof of concept with correct client patterns.

use_cases.title: Add Retrieval to an Existing Service
use_cases.description: Follow the Azure AI Search and citation guidance to plan a RAG feature in C#.

use_cases.title: Review SDK Usage Before Release
use_cases.description: Compare implementation choices against authentication, retry, streaming, and tool validation recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Right Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain which Azure.AI.OpenAI client I should use for chat completions in a new .NET project.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Chat to Streaming
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me change a basic Azure OpenAI chat call in C# into a streaming response pattern.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a .NET RAG flow that uses Azure OpenAI with Azure AI Search and returns citations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Azure OpenAI .NET design for authentication, retries, token usage, tool calls, and error handling.

output_examples.input: I need to authenticate an Azure OpenAI .NET service in production.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Entra ID with DefaultAzureCredential, reused client instances, and environment-based endpoint configuration.

output_examples.input: I want chat responses to appear as they are generated.
output_examples.output: The skill points to the streaming chat pattern and explains how to process response updates incrementally.

output_examples.input: I need retrieval with document citations in C#.
output_examples.output: The skill describes Azure AI Search integration, data source configuration, and citation handling for RAG responses.

best_practices: Prefer Entra ID authentication for production services and keep API keys out of source control.
Reuse SDK clients, handle rate limits, and monitor token usage for cost and reliability.
Validate tool call arguments before invoking application functions.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real Azure endpoints, API keys, deployment names, or search keys in application code.
Do not create a new SDK client for every request in a high-traffic service.
Do not execute model-requested tool calls without validation and authorization checks.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands or install packages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents package commands and SDK examples for the user to apply manually.

faq.question: Which authentication method does it recommend for production?
faq.answer: It recommends Microsoft Entra ID with DefaultAzureCredential for production workloads.

faq.question: Can it help with non-Azure OpenAI usage?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes notes for OpenAI SDK compatibility with Azure endpoints.

faq.question: Does it cover embeddings and RAG?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes embeddings examples and Azure AI Search integration guidance.

faq.question: Does it include image and audio examples?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers image generation, audio transcription, and text-to-speech SDK patterns.

faq.question: Will it verify my Azure subscription or deployment?
faq.answer: No. It provides SDK guidance, but live Azure configuration must be verified separately.
